port.title: UDP Listen Port
port.description: Local port for receiving device responses.

scanAddress.title: Scan Broadcast Address
scanAddress.description: Broadcast address used to discover devices on the LAN.

scanCount.title: Scan Attempts
scanCount.description: Number of discovery broadcasts before giving up.

statusUpdateInterval.title: Status Poll Interval (s)
statusUpdateInterval.description: Seconds between status polls after the device is bound.

mac.title: Device MAC (optional)
mac.description: Optional MAC address to match a specific device (e.g. aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff).

climateName.title: Climate Tile Name
climateName.description: Name of the space heating/cooling thermostat in HomeKit.

enableHotWater.title: Expose Hot Water (DHW) Thermostat
enableHotWater.description: Adds a second thermostat for the domestic hot water tank.

hotWaterName.title: Hot Water Tile Name
hotWaterName.description: Name of the hot water thermostat in HomeKit.

outdoorTemperatureSensor.title: Expose Outdoor Temperature Sensor (experimental)
outdoorTemperatureSensor.description: Adds a temperature sensor from the OutEnvTem field. Its unit has not been verified on ATW devices; enable diagnostics to check the raw value first.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics Logging
diagnostics.description: Logs every changed status field at info level. Useful to identify unknown parameters.

extraStatusCols.title: Extra Status Columns
extraStatusCols.description: Additional status fields to request from the device and log (e.g. RmoHomTemHi, RmoHomTemLo, ColHtWter, HetHtWter, LefHom).
